title: Coffee and sugar body scrub
subtitle: An energising scrub for arms, legs, and dry patches
excerpt: Ground coffee and granulated sugar in a coconut oil base, with peppermint essential oil. Exfoliates and brightens dull skin. Use in the shower. Makes one 200 ml jar.
sourceNotes: Coffee grounds as exfoliant in cosmetic scrubs: general cosmetic science reference (particle size and skin-safe abrasive classification). Peppermint essential oil cautions for young children and pets: ASPCA and general aromatherapy reference. Coconut oil as carrier: CIR safety assessment (open access).

recipe.batchNotes: Doubles to 400 ml in a larger jar.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Make a jar and keep it in the shower; mixes in ten minutes.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Keeps two months in a sealed jar in a cool, dry bathroom cupboard. Water introduced during use can cause mould; always use a dry spoon or clean hands to scoop. Discard if the scrub smells sour, changes colour, or develops any mould on the surface.

glossaryTerms.definition: A granular ingredient that mechanically removes dead skin cells by abrasion. Ground coffee and granulated sugar are both physical exfoliants. Coffee grounds are firm with rounded edges that are safe on intact skin; sugar dissolves during use, making it gentler than salt.

content.text: This is a shower scrub of ground coffee and granulated sugar in a coconut oil base. Ground coffee and sugar are both

that lift dead skin cells; the coconut oil leaves the skin moisturised after rinsing. The peppermint essential oil adds a cooling, energising sensation. Use on arms, legs, elbows, and knees. Not for the face, which needs a finer exfoliant.
Peppermint essential oil is toxic to cats and dogs and should not be used on young children's skin.

items.prepNote: fine or medium-ground; used coffee grounds work well and reduce waste
granulated white sugar; dissolves during use for a gentler finish
refined coconut oil for a neutral scent; melt gently if solid
rinse-off product; cooling sensation; toxic to pets; omit in pet-friendly households

content.text: Melt the coconut oil gently until liquid if it is solid.
Allow to cool to room temperature.
Combine the ground coffee and sugar in a bowl. Add the cooled coconut oil and the peppermint essential oil. Stir until evenly combined.
Spoon into a wide-mouth glass jar. Seal.

Scoop a tablespoon with a dry spoon or clean hands. Apply to damp skin in the shower and massage in circles. Rinse well. Coffee grounds will stain a light-coloured bath or shower tray; rinse the tray immediately after use.
Keeps two months in a sealed jar at room temperature. Always use a dry spoon to avoid introducing water, which shortens the shelf life. Discard if the scrub develops mould or an off smell.
